title: Recording a set result retries before giving up
outcome: A transient failure while recording which side won the set repairs itself inside the same request, so the recorder never sees it. Only a failure that survives every attempt is reported as unconfirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: The set-result write is retried a fixed number of times with growing pauses before the response is sent, and the counts and pauses are stated in one place rather than scattered.
A set result that succeeds on a later attempt is reported as confirmed, and the recorder sees an ordinary success.
A set result that fails every attempt is reported as unconfirmed while the entries still come back.
The retryable flag the error model already declares is what decides whether to retry, giving that flag its first consumer in the repository.
An error that is not retryable is not retried.
